paraphrase.title: At the boathouse
paraphrase.body: A small wooden rowing craft sits under tarpaulin beside the boathouse. Its name, painted across the transom, is Vitsippa.
paraphrase.question: What is Mara's dinghy called?

paraphrase.title: Courtyard collections
paraphrase.body: Refuse and sorted material leave the courtyard early each Wednesday; the caretaker moves the containers the evening prior.
paraphrase.question: What day is rubbish collected at the flat?

paraphrase.title: Aloft
paraphrase.body: On any flight she asks for a place beside the gangway, never against the porthole — easier to rise and stretch stiff wrists.
paraphrase.question: Which seat does Mara book on planes?

paraphrase.title: Practice
paraphrase.body: Twice a month she lifts the kora down from its case and works through pieces Kwame taught her.
paraphrase.question: Which musical instrument does Mara play?

paraphrase.title: If the building empties
paraphrase.body: Should the block be evacuated, the household gathers by the chestnut tree at the far end of the courtyard.
paraphrase.question: Where does Mara's family regroup during a fire?
paraphrase.gold: by the chestnut tree at the end of the courtyard

paraphrase.title: Side responsibility
paraphrase.body: She looks after a small internal utility that reconciles warehouse counts overnight; colleagues refer to it as Tallyho.
paraphrase.question: What is the in-house program Mara maintains called?

paraphrase.title: Loaves
paraphrase.body: Loaves come from the bakery on Karl Johansgatan, the one with the blue awning, every second morning.
paraphrase.question: Which shop does Mara get her bread from?

paraphrase.title: Platform footprint
paraphrase.body: Everything at Nordvik runs on Amazon's platform; the migration off the old racks finished two winters ago.
paraphrase.question: Which cloud vendor does Mara's employer use?

paraphrase.title: Saturdays
paraphrase.body: The elder child spends Saturday mornings at the climbing hall in Gamlestaden and has done since she was seven.
paraphrase.question: What activity does Nell do at weekends?

paraphrase.title: Seasonal rubber
paraphrase.body: Winter rubber goes onto the estate in the opening week of November and comes off around Easter.
paraphrase.question: When does Mara swap her car tyres?
